title: Merging AI Incidents Research with Political Misinformation Research: Introducing the Political Deepfakes Incidents Database
reasoning: The paper introduces the Political Deepfakes Incidents Database (PDID), an incident-tracking dataset. While it mentions 'AI ethics' as a relevant field and includes 'morality' as one of the frames for coding how media content is presented, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within AI systems.
